configuration_text.para: If EL2 is not implemented, this register is RES0 from EL3.

field_description.para: Trap execution of PSB CSYNC at EL1 and EL0 using AArch64 to EL2.

field_value_description.para: Execution of PSB CSYNC is not trapped by this mechanism.

If EL2 is implemented and enabled in the current Security state, the Effective value of HCR_EL2.{E2H, TGE} is not {1, 1}, and either EL3 is not implemented or SCR_EL3.FGTEn == 1, then execution of PSB CSYNC at EL1 and EL0 using AArch64 is trapped to EL2 and reported with EC syndrome value 0x0A, unless the instruction generates a higher priority exception.
